name: Javascript Timer API - Clock
description: Uses the Javascript Timer API to provide a clock widget.
project_description: Submodule of the Javascript Timer API (jstimer) project. Registers the 'jst_clock' live-clock widget through hook_jstwidget(): it compiles the clock JavaScript into the shared jstimer.js file, adds the clock-type and SVG-file settings to the jstimer admin form, and provides the jst_clock_show() theme function. Supports four clock renderings updated every second by the shared jstimer loop: 12-hour text, 24-hour text, an HTML canvas analog clock, and an SVG analog clock loaded from the widgets/clocks directory.
